editorial.blurb: India Garden delivers consistently excellent, high-value Indian cuisine with warm hospitality and a welcoming atmosphere that makes every visit feel like coming home.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Chana Masala and Garlic Naan together—reviewers rave about how the pillowy, garlic-herb naan is the perfect vehicle for mopping up the rich, balanced tomato-based gravy.

topDishes.note: Perfectly tender chickpeas in a rich, savory tomato-based gravy with ideal balance of tang and heat
Warm, pillowy, generously topped with fresh garlic and herbs—the perfect companion to curries
Incredibly tender and flavorful; reviewers ate every piece and wished for more
